title: The Great Nether Challenge
description: A mod designed to be a new challenge and experience for streamers, youtubers, friends, whomever! It has a progressive episode and phase system to bring survival to it's highest level.
body: A fun new mod to bring a new survival and challenge experience to minecraft, upon typing the "/portal start" command you will be sent into a vote count to ensure the others on the world will be prepared for the challenge. If the vote count succeeds you will be sent to the nether with 3 hour episode intervals. The first hour will have you be braving the nether and it's hostile environment, the second phase in the second hour will allow you in the overworld, but be warned, failure to get back to the nether before the phase timer goes out will mean your demise! The final hour will be also restricted to the nether. You can change time and episode count at your leisure. Episode 3, 4, and 5 will make the game switch to hard difficulty to up the ante. Episode 6 and beyond will be in hardcore mode where you will be challenged, one wrong move may end your whole adventure.... are you ready?
